remarks: Experience coastal living at its finest! This is a spacious, updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment in the heart of East Norwalk's Seaside Village. Enjoy beautiful water views just steps from your door, an ideal setting for morning coffee, evening walks, and everything in between. Inside, the bright and modern layout features generous living space, stylish upgrades, and the convenience of in-unit laundry. Parking is included, making everyday living effortless. All of this in an unbeatable location, walk to shoreline paths, marinas, shopping, and some of the area's best restaurants. A rare chance to live where the water, convenience, and lifestyle all come together.
